_meta._note: AAII v4.0.4 per-benchmark sub-scores extracted via Playwright from https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/gpt-5-5 detail page. Each chart shows 28 frontier models. For models with multiple reasoning effort variants (xhigh/high/medium/low/Non-reasoning), highest score per canonical model_id is kept. 12th chart (18 entries) skipped due to uncertain benchmark attribution.
